in_marathi.name: Tripura
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tripura हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Tripura refers to the three cities built by the demon king, Tripura Asura. Tripura is often depicted as a symbol of power and destruction. The gods, led by Lord Shiva, finally destroy the cities to restore peace and order.

vedic_reference.note: In Hindu mythology, Tripura refers to the three cities of the Asuras (demons). These cities were created by the Asura king, Mahasur, and were protected by his three daughters, Tripura Sundari, Tripura Bhairavi, and Tripura Triyambaka.
